outcome: Duration of second stage of labor
cohort: 612 women admitted for labor in AMU from 2010 to 2017, compared to 612 low-risk women who gave birth in standard obstetric care during the same period
finding: Compared to births in a consultant-led obstetric unit, the outcome of births planned in the AMU was not inferior, and intervention rates were lower.
birth_weight: Infants born in AMU had an average birthweight 95 g higher than those born in the consultant-led unit.
